territories.name: Trinidad and Tobago
territories.legal_reference: Directive 2006/112/EC, article 5(2): the common system of VAT applies in the territory of the Community as defined by the Treaties, and a State outside it is a third country for every rule the Directive carries. Trinidad and Tobago levies a value added tax of its own under the Value Added Tax Act, Chap. 75:06, administered by the Inland Revenue Division: a standard rate of 12.5 per cent, zero rating for the goods and services of Schedule 2 (exports among them), and exemption for the services of Schedule 1.
